title: Bandwidth Saturation: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: The highway is jammed at rush hour. Some cars wait, and some are turned away. A busy link does exactly the same.

scenes.heading: Highway congestion
scenes.narration: A link fills up when too much traffic arrives at once. Sustained use above seventy percent is a warning. Above ninety percent is critical. The key symptom is output drops on the interface. I perf measures the real throughput between two points.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three tips. It just means the link is busy. Output drops are the real clue. I perf measures throughput.

items.wrong: Full usage always means a fault

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Seventy percent is a warning, and ninety is critical. Look for output drops. Test with I perf. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva saturation lab.
